bullets.text: Pixel 10 Expands Magic Cue - **Google** is enhancing the Pixel 10’s Magic Cue with **Tasks** and **Wallet** integration.
iPhone 18 Pro Rumors - New **display technology** may hide **Face ID** under the screen, raising questions about **Dynamic Island**.
Samsung Home Up Upgrade - **One UI 8.5** brings new customization features to **Samsung** Galaxy phones’ Home Up module.
OpenAI's 2026 Focus - **OpenAI** aims for practical AI adoption, targeting sectors like health and enterprise.
Everstone Merges for Growth - **Everstone** combines **Wingify** and **AB Tasty** to create a $100M digital optimization platform.
AI Security Investment Surge - VCs are increasingly funding **AI security** startups to combat rogue AI agents.
Bungie's Marathon Launch - **Bungie** announces the release date for **Marathon**, set for March 5th at $39.99.
Apple's Creator Studio Launch - **Apple** introduces a subscription for its Creator Studio, bundling pro tools for $13/month.
Google Clock Update - **Google Clock** 8.5 introduces a swipe-to-dismiss feature for alarms, enhancing user experience.
Threads Surpasses X - **Meta's Threads** now has more daily mobile users than **X**, marking significant growth.
